reader.requirement: At --std 85 every file-name in a SAME AREA or SAME RECORD AREA clause must name a file in the FILE-CONTROL paragraph of the same program; a name that is undefined, a data-name, or a GLOBAL file of a containing program must be refused.
reader.edition-search: grep Edition.Edition|DialectLevel|CobolVersion in FileControlBinder.IoControl.cs: the only edition test is SameOccurrenceRule (Edition.Edition.Year < 2002, the report-file row of SR3's occurrence limits), which serves a neighbouring rule; ScreenSameOperands uses Edition.At for position only and looks the name up in this unit's FilesByName.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness names a file not in FILE-CONTROL; not exercised: a data-name operand, the SAME RECORD AREA form, a containing program's GLOBAL file

probes.printed: COBOL2738 SAME AREA: 'FX' is not a file specified in the FILE-CONTROL paragraph; COBOL2738 SAME RECORD AREA: 'D1' is not a file ...
COBOL2738 SAME AREA: 'FG' is not a file specified in the FILE-CONTROL paragraph of this source element
probes.expected: refused: FG is a GLOBAL file of the containing program, not in this program's FILE-CONTROL
SAME RECORD AREA FOR F1 F2 F3 with SAME AREA FOR F3 F2 F1 accepted, F2's record views F1's record area

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.2.13.3 SR1  (2.13.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1 [must be specified in the FILE-CONTROL paragraph of the same program]

OK  §1985:VII.2.13.3 SR3c  (2.13.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR3c [all of the file-names in that SAME AREA clause must appear in the SAME RECORD AREA clause] (why the first r56ok draft was refused)

reader.notes: ScreenSameOperands resolves each operand against this unit's own FilesByName, which a containing program's GLOBAL files join only after the unit's data binds, so undefined names, data-names and inherited GLOBAL files are all refused with COBOL2738. The first draft of the acceptance probe drew the correct SR3c refusal.

refuter.evidence: Read FileControlBinder.IoControl.cs#ScreenSameOperands (looks each operand up in this unit's FilesByName; no edition test). q5nest.cob (--compile-only): the containing program's SAME AREA naming a file only the contained program selects -> COBOL2738, and the contained program naming the container's non-GLOBAL file -> COBOL2738. q5ok.cob (run): a contained program's own file that shadows the container's GLOBAL file of the same name is admitted in its SAME RECORD AREA and shares the record (FKR=WXYZ). q5g2.cob (run): a program's own GLOBAL file in its own SAME AREA is admitted (OK). q5g.cob: the same file in SAME RECORD AREA is refused COBOL2738, a correct 1985 rule (§1985:X.4.6.3 SR3), not this one. cite.py: OK §1985:VII.2.13.3 SR1 [must be specified in the FILE-CONTROL paragraph of the same program]; OK §1985:X.4.6.3 SR3 [must not include the GLOBAL clause].
